results.name: Background-return event across midnight recomputes elapsed/rest from timestamps; pending set input and storage remain unchanged
Explicitly saved incomplete inputs, active workout identity and expired rest restore after reload
Paused session retains remaining rest through background gap; resume excludes paused time and uses a new deadline
Open note editor and unsaved multiline input survive foreground-return/day refresh without a write
Same-day foreground return updates nearest event even when the main content landmark retains focus
Foreground return after emulated timezone change refreshes Today display from 11:00 to 05:00 without rewriting source dates or timezone
No workout interval or one-second timer wake remains while Today is open, even with a stored active session
Repeated route/visibility/page lifecycle changes leave exactly one visible workout interval and remove it when hidden
Paused workout has no ticking interval; resuming restarts one timer without duplicate listeners

conditions: Linux Chromium 390×844, fresh synthetic profiles, controlled browser clock, CDP-emulated timezone and synthetic visibility/focus/page lifecycle events. No physical OS background/keyboard/device test.

beforeFix.kind: demonstration of unnecessary idle wake, not an FPS comparison

afterFix.kind: lifecycle assertion, not a matched CPU/FPS benchmark

limitations: Pending input is retained in a live page; a mobile OS may terminate that page. Explicit Save inputs is required before deliberate reload. No durable unsaved-draft recovery is claimed.
